mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates on equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the average 20d return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppressing equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in > 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.5%, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction starts above 1.6 million units signals strong household demand and confidence, which drives consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 1600.0, or the average 60d return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 113.0 indicates weakening manufacturing activity and broad economic contraction, reducing corporate profitability and triggering risk-off sentiment, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in > 60% of periods when INDPRO < 113.0, or the average 20d return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both real personal consumption expenditures and residential investment signals strong aggregate demand, which increases corporate revenue visibility and supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances where both RSAFS and HOUST are rising, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in CPI inflation above 2.0% combined with a stable federal funds rate signals persistent inflationary pressure, prompting the Fed to delay rate cuts and maintain high discount rates, which suppresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 2.0 and FEDFUNDS <= 5.5%, or the average 5d return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in payroll employment and a decline in unemployment rate signals a labor market recovery that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in < 40% of instances where PAYEMS > 0.3% MoM and UNRATE < 4.7%, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real GDP growth above 2.0% annualized combined with rising residential investment signals strong economic momentum, which increases corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in < 40% of instances where GDPC1 > 11300.0 and HOUST > 1650.0, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
